comment:
* BatteryStatsHistory encapsulates battery history files.
 * Battery history record is appended into buffer {@link #mHistoryBuffer} and backed up into
 * {@link #mActiveFile}.
 * When {@link #mHistoryBuffer} size reaches {@link BatteryStatsImpl.Constants#MAX_HISTORY_BUFFER},
 * current mActiveFile is closed and a new mActiveFile is open.
 * History files are under directory /data/system/battery-history/.
 * History files have name battery-history-<num>.bin. The file number <num> starts from zero and
 * grows sequentially.
 * The mActiveFile is always the highest numbered history file.
 * The lowest number file is always the oldest file.
 * The highest number file is always the newest file.
 * The file number grows sequentially and we never skip number.
 * When count of history files exceeds {@link BatteryStatsImpl.Constants#MAX_HISTORY_FILES},
 * the lowest numbered file is deleted and a new file is open.
 *
 * All interfaces in BatteryStatsHistory should only be called by BatteryStatsImpl and protected by
 * locks on BatteryStatsImpl object.

variables.comment: Part of initial delta int that specifies the time delta.

variables.comment: The delta is a following long

variables.name: DELTA_TIME_INT
variables.comment: The delta is a following int

variables.name: DELTA_TIME_ABS
variables.comment: Following is an entire abs update.

variables.name: DELTA_BATTERY_LEVEL_FLAG
variables.comment: Flag in delta int: a new battery level int follows.

variables.name: DELTA_STATE_FLAG
variables.comment: Flag in delta int: a new full state and battery status int follows.

variables.name: DELTA_STATE2_FLAG
variables.comment: Flag in delta int: a new full state2 int follows.

variables.name: DELTA_WAKELOCK_FLAG
variables.comment: Flag in delta int: contains a wakelock or wakeReason tag.

variables.name: DELTA_EVENT_FLAG
variables.comment: Flag in delta int: contains an event description.

variables.name: DELTA_BATTERY_CHARGE_FLAG
variables.comment: Flag in delta int: contains the battery charge count in uAh.

variables.name: DELTA_STATE_MASK
variables.comment: These upper bits are the frequently changing state bits.

variables.name: STATE_BATTERY_MASK
variables.comment: in STATE_BATTERY_MASK.

variables.name: BATTERY_LEVEL_DETAILS_FLAG
variables.comment: from a battery level change.

variables.name: TAG_FIRST_OCCURRENCE_FLAG
variables.comment: therefore the tag value is written in the parcel

variables.name: STATE1_TRACE_MASK
variables.comment: suspend) and the running bit (which isn't meaningful in traces).

variables.name: STATE2_TRACE_MASK
variables.comment: For state2, trace all bit changes.

variables.name: EXTRA_BUFFER_SIZE_WHEN_DIR_LOCKED
variables.comment:
* Number of overflow bytes that can be written into the history buffer if the history
     * directory is locked. This is done to prevent a long lock contention and a potential
     * kill by a watchdog.

variables.name: mActiveFile
variables.comment: * The active history file that the history buffer is backed up into.

variables.name: mHistoryDir
variables.comment: * A list of history files with increasing timestamps.

variables.name: mHistoryParcels
variables.comment:
* A list of small history parcels, used when BatteryStatsImpl object is created from
     * deserialization of a parcel, such as Settings app or checkin file.

variables.name: mCurrentFile
variables.comment: * When iterating history files, the current file index.

variables.name: mCurrentParcel
variables.comment: * When iterating history files, the current file parcel.

variables.name: mCurrentParcelEnd
variables.comment: * When iterating history file, the current parcel's Parcel.dataSize().

variables.name: mParcelIndex
variables.comment:
* Used when BatteryStatsImpl object is created from deserialization of a parcel,

variables.comment: Monotonic time when we started writing to the history buffer
